title: Preserve the provenance and status of AI-generated information
requirements:
- Require systems to distinguish observed, asserted, calculated and inferred information
- Add machine-generated or machine-drafted status, with the responsible tool and reviewer, to the provenance row of Table 2.2 and to the LHR description
- State that AI outputs affecting care, eligibility or resources need a human author of record before entering the LHR
- State that automatically generated or AI-assisted semantic content is draft until human-reviewed and validated
- Prevent generated content silently overwriting authoritative data; control write-back
- Require provenance for generated content
- Require end-to-end lineage from source through model to output
